title: Polyalkylene terephthalates (PET and PBT) for moulding and extrusion
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and tests for polyalkylene terephthalate materials for moulding and extrusion. 1.2 This standard is intended to be used for identification and characterization of polyalkylene terephthalate materials on the basis of basic polymer parameters and recommended end-uses.
